illustration-playfool-server.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 3:2 conceptual editorial illustration for TECTONICA design magazine. illustration-rca-inresponse.creator: TECTONICA
illustration-rca-inresponse.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for TECTONICA design magazine about graduate product design as research into memory, material and the human body. A beautifully composed designer's experimental workbench: hand-built clay and wood ergonomic study models, small translucent material samples, a wire contour of a seated human body and layered pencil sketches, three interrelated visual clusters. No actual RCA student projects, no branding, no portraits. Sophisticated tactile gouache and paper collage, warm ivory, charcoal, muted sage and terracotta, subtle print grain, generous space, visually specific to design research. No text or logos. Visibly conceptual illustration not photograph.

illustration-paris-hanji.creator: TECTONICA
illustration-paris-hanji.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 3:2 conceptual editorial illustration for TECTONICA about contemporary design using Korean hanji mulberry paper. Beautiful translucent handmade ivory paper sheets, curling folds and exposed fine mulberry fibers, with an abstract folded sculptural lamp glowing softly through the paper. Show material qualities and craft, not replicas of works from the Hanjimania exhibition. Refined cut-paper collage with gouache and delicate pencil accents, warm ivory, muted sage, charcoal and very restrained terracotta, sophisticated architectural magazine aesthetic. No Paris clichés, no text, no logos, no photographic documentation.

illustration-bocci-labyrinth.creator: TECTONICA
illustration-bocci-labyrinth.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for TECTONICA about purple portable light and a dreamlike labyrinth. A single luminous purple glass-like sphere nested in an imaginary maze of folded architectural paper walls and slender colored totems; impossible paths and theatrical shadows evoke cinematic fantasy. This is a freely imagined visual metaphor, NOT a reconstruction of Bocci 14p or Bethan Laura Wood's actual installation, do not duplicate their design. Refined tactile gouache and cut-paper collage on ivory paper, deep aubergine violet glow as focus, muted sage and charcoal geometry with small terracotta accent, subtle print grain, elegant composition. No text, logos, faces or watermarks; visibly editorial art.
